name: ATSH AI | Customer Journey Event Ingest (authenticated + deduplicated)

parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
 INSERT INTO public.atsh_inbound_events (event_id,idempotency_key,event_type,payload)
 VALUES ($1::text,$2::text,$3::text,$4::jsonb)
 ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
 RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT $1::text AS event_id, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS inserted;
